abstract: Maintains winch installations, mechanical tension ratings, and oceanographic over-the-side handling gear records
system_message:
You are the Scientific deck operations lead (DECK), responsible for maintaining records regarding oceanographic over-the-side handling gear, deep-tow winch installations, and certified mechanical tension ratings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: A-frame deck handling（CRANE）
information_points.content:
DECK-CRANE-8MR：For the Autonomous robotic survey package, statutory lifting registers record a stern A-frame safe working load of 30 tonnes under sea state 5 dynamic conditions.
DECK-CRANE-383：For the Hybrid benthic coring package, the stern A-frame safe working load is rated at 25 tonnes under sea state 5 dynamic conditions according to the lifting equipment statutory register.
DECK-CRANE-Z75：For the Deep-tow acoustic mapping package, the statutory lifting register records a stern A-frame safe working load of 20 tonnes under sea state 5 dynamic conditions.

information_points.title: Maintains winch installations, mechanical tension ratings, and oceanographic over-the-side handling gear records（WINCH）
information_points.content:
DECK-WINCH-DB6：For the Deep-tow acoustic mapping package, the vessel deck configuration includes a verified heavy-duty deep-tow winch installation, and the winch assembly possesses a certified continuous deep-tow winch tension capacity of 25 tonnes under continuous oceanographic deployment load.
DECK-WINCH-GJG：For the Autonomous robotic survey package, the vessel deck configuration confirms a verified heavy-duty deep-tow winch installation, and the winch assembly holds a certified continuous deep-tow winch tension capacity of 25 tonnes under continuous oceanographic deployment load.
DECK-WINCH-VKU：For the Hybrid benthic coring package, physical commissioning confirms a heavy-duty deep-tow winch installation on the deck configuration, with a certified continuous deep-tow winch tension capacity of 10 tonnes under continuous oceanographic deployment load.
